claim: the granule-cell-lineage receptor state capable of receiving the aging niche secretome is associated with cognitive resilience/vulnerability
claim_ceiling: do NOT claim high receptor expression = strong secretome stimulation; transcriptional response supported only if downstream-target enrichment concords

ligand_to_receptor.rule: use whole 2021-12-21 network as-is; intersect 34 UP symbols with lr_network.from; direct receptors lr_network.to; dedupe receptor to one gene in primary; select edges blind to RES/SAD; forbidden to keep only RES/SAD-different receptors
ligand_to_receptor.note: final receptor set frozen at Phase A1 (post-tag) after CTRL expression filter

expression_filter.adopt_rule: >=3 of 6 CTRL donors detectable in >=1 SGCZ maturation subtype
expression_filter.sensitivity_only: label-blind all-group pooled filter (never changes primary set)

primary_score.formula: per-receptor logCPM -> per-receptor z across RES+SAD donor x subtype samples -> mean over frozen receptors -> one score per donor x subtype
primary_score.weighting: equal weight; no network-degree / NicheNet-weight / RES-SAD-effect weighting in primary

maturation.mature_score_rule: equal-weight mean of donor-level NTF3 score and CHRM3 score (NOT raw-count pool)

primary_model.primary_estimand: stage-averaged (equal weight across 2 stages) marginal SAD - RES contrast
primary_model.report: effect size + CI; cell counts NOT used as df
primary_model.run_handling: (1|Run) random; partial modelling not batch-adjustment; Run nests donor; RES/SAD Run-imbalanced; group-Run confound not fully removable

singular_fit_policy: report singular fit + Run variance; fallback to donor-random-only; compare with Run-fixed; never pick most significant

nichenet_supporting.target_rule: top-50 regulatory-potential targets per frozen UP ligand, restricted to CTRL-granule-detectable
nichenet_supporting.test: competitive gene-set enrichment of frozen target set on donor-level RES-vs-SAD ranking (stat = SAD - RES model statistic; positive = targets higher in SAD)
